reviews.text:
I LOVE everything about this place. I interacted with several staff members, every single one of them were very sociable and generous with their time toward my self & my puppy. Honestly not an ounce of worry leaving him in their care. Warmest welcome ever!

My emails were answered promptly, I received picture updates via email and had access to live footage of the playroom. Even received the cutest report card following his visit.

10/10 thank you for everything guys. See you soon!!

Nooshy was a GODSEND when I started a new job and realized that my 50lb boxer mix, Teddy was NOT about to handle being home alone well AT ALL.
To make matters worse, ALL the other daycares hours were until 6 or 7pm at the LATEST. - my hours were 9-6 so with traffic or a delay, I might not make that 7pm cut off reliably.
Then a friend recommended NOOSHY.
- AMAZING HOURS
- Wonderful staff
- WEBCAM ACCESS
- multiple rooms so dogs arent with dogs that they are uncomfortable with
- Decent prices (I will say a monthly unlimited access pass for like Xhours per day or x days per month would be such a great option to have because when I was taking Ted there 5-6x per week, it absolutely added up. Mind you, it was my only option and a great value for him but a monthly membership would be so convenient!)

My puppy has been visiting Nooshy for over 8 months, and she always has a wonderful time there. Coco absolutely loves it! With my busy work schedule, I knew I needed a trustworthy daycare to care for my puppy, and I couldn't be happier with their services. She's never been hurt, and she always comes home happy and excited to play. I just wanted to take a moment to sincerely thank the entire staff for their care and kindness. — COCO CHANEL'S MOM
Fantastic Service! We appreciate the time Tara took to build a bond with our mini poodle. He looks handsome and we’ll definitely be back!
Good service
Super friendly and professional staff. Great care for my dog whenever we come into town!

Absolutely unacceptable experience. The grooming job on both of my dogs was sloppy and clearly rushed, yet I was overcharged as if I received premium service. To make matters worse, they added a “handling fee” after the fact, with no proper explanation or warning beforehand.

You don’t get to do a poor job and then tack on extra charges to justify it. If my dog supposedly required special handling, that should have been discussed before the appointment—not used as an excuse to inflate the bill.

This place lacks transparency, professionalism, and basic respect for customers. Save your money and take your pet somewhere that actually delivers what they charge for.
We have been using Nooshy/ Dogtopia as our main daycare for a long time. Our dog has a great time playing with her friends and the daycare attendants :)
Really kind and helpful, always do a great job with my dog's grooming.

Great location.  Staff very efficient about checking dogs in and out.  It is apparent they truly love dogs.  Our dog happily trots in upon arrival . Location is very clean and our dog never has a “ kennel” smell when we pick him up.
I love how much my dog loves it here! This team is reliable, pleasant, professional and responsible.
Amazing staff
The staff was friendly and attentive. They took really great care of Ellie.
The team at Dogtopia BLOOR west are great! My dog has been going there for 3 years and loves it there! He literally runs in the door. And we use them for boarding too - it’s safe and familiar to him.

The staff and owner are awesome!  They all know Merlin by name and they are all very caring and loving.  I never think twice about leaving him and apparently, he doesn't miss me when I drop him off.....a great sign of a happy doggie!  Thanks everyone.  The photo is after a day at Dogtopia.  My boy is pooped.

Where to begin..

Originally we had a dog walker for Zoey to take her out for an hour a day, twice a week.  While the dog walker was amazing, we wanted more for her.  After doing the math, we realized for another $25 a week, Zoey could go to dogtopia twice a week for 12 hrs a day.

That was well over a year ago, and we are eternally grateful for Dogtopia Bloor West.  Zoey enjoyed 2 days a week, getting dropped off around 7 am, and then picked up around 6:30/7 pm.  Throughout the day we could always check the Dogtopia cameras and see what shenanigans the dogs were up to, and it was always amazing to see our dog running around with all her friends (OR, just having a nap!)

Zoey has done day care, the occasional overnight boarding, and grooming sessions at Dogtopia, all with absolutely 0 issues.  The staff are amazingly understanding, patient, responsive and informative with any and all dog questions you may have.  Special shout out to Irene, who always had a fun recap of the days events.

Thursday, December 19th was a very bittersweet moment as it was Zoeys last day at Dogtopia, as we're moving out of the city.  It's going to be VERY hard to replace the enrichment and community Dogtopia provided Zoey and us, but rest assured we'll pop in now and then to say hi to all the wonderful people!

Thank you Dogtopia!
Staff are amazing, my fur baby gets the exersize and social interaction she deserves. Highly reccomend
